text:
Anu: quick heads-up — warmstart for Polestar-11B-int6 finished microbench. Throughput up, cost down, but a regression popped on long-form summarization slices. Anyone else seeing this?
Diego: saw it on the news-article slice too. ROUGE-L down ~2.8 and a subtle rise in factual hallucinations for anchor prompts. latency tail looks OK.
Priya: can you paste the slice IDs + seeds? want to repro.
Anu: slice ids: news_long_v2, legal_case_priming, user_story_long. seeds and eval command:
```
python eval.py --model polestar-11b-int6 --slices news_long_v2,legal_case_priming --seed 42 --samples 1000
```
results snapshot (summary):
- int8 baseline: ROUGE-L 45.2, hallucination rate 3.1%
- int6 warmstart: ROUGE-L 42.4, hallucination rate 5.0%
- cost delta: ~-13% per-token for int6 vs int8
Anu: curious tradeoff: ~13% cost reduction buys a 2.8 ROUGE-L drop on these long slices. Product will push back if longform quality is user-visible.
Chris: ops question — can we do hybrid routing by route type? short Q/A and chat -> int6, longform -> int8. That keeps most econ win but protects longform UX.
Priya: that seems reasonable. what's the traffic mix for product? if longform is <10% of calls, net econ wins remain.
Anu: product gave a rough mix: 82% short chat, 12% medium, 6% longform (but longform is high-value).
Diego: quick unit-econ calc i did:
- int8 cost ~= $0.045 per 1k tokens
- int6 cost ~= $0.039 per 1k tokens (-13%)
- avg tokens/short call = 40, medium = 200, long = 1,200
- weighted avg per-call cost delta (current mix) ~= $0.0008 per call saved -> at 1M calls/day ~ $800/day saved if everything went int6.
Diego: but if we route longform->int8 and rest->int6 net save ~ $700/day (still material).
Nia: @ops-bot created canary route `polestar-int6-canary` at 8% traffic to staging. Link: https://console/re/redwood/routes/1234 :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Canary route polestar-int6-canary created. Monitor group: @eng-ml @eng-oncall.
Priya: short-term plan:
- Block traffic: longform -> int8, rest -> int6-canary (Chris/Nia to configure)
- Run targeted human eval on the 3 longform slices (Priya) — 200 judgments each by Friday
- Run small priming/temperature sweep on int6 for longform (Diego) to see if sampling fixes hallucination
- If int6 still bad for longform, we flag for quant-aware ft or distillation (Anu + Research)
Chris: ops will schedule routing change and smoke tests this afternoon. I’ll also add latency/cost alerts to the route dashboard.
Anu: medium-term idea: quant-aware fine-tune on longform prompts + KV-cache warmstart. If that recovers quality, we can expand int6.
Priya: agree. also add a gating eval (ROUGE-L + hallucination rate) to rollout windows so we don't regress silently.
Diego: one more note — batch sizing changed slightly in the warmstart images (we were more aggressive). I'll revert to previous batch size on a dev run to see effect on hallucination.
Anu: TL;DR actions with owners:
- Chris/Nia: implement hybrid routing + canary -> today (ops)
- Priya: human eval on long slices -> Fri EOD (product/QA)
- Diego: sampling/bsweep + dev run revert -> Thu EOD (eng-ml)
- Anu + Research: plan quant-aware ft / distill if needed -> next week
Anu: thanks all — we want the econ wins but not at the cost of user-visible longform quality. ping if you need more data. :rocket:
